scenes.summary: You find UWST equipment next to a heavily wounded Landbreaker, but the LB claims that he salvaged it earlier. You cannot tell if the LB is lying, but there is a good chance that the missing crew mates might still be alive.

lines.text: Where did you get this stuff, breaker? Where are the UWST crew mates?
*Mumbles*......
What did you just say?
Hurk... hurhur... I'se ... picked it up...
Picked it up?
We're still quite far from the place where their signals went dark.
If the Landbreaker wasn't lying to us, it means our missing crew mates might just be around here... There's a good possibility that they are still alive.
Let's keep looking for Noffman.
Wait... This looks like UWST equipment.

scenes.summary: You find Noffman. He is feeling bad about another unsuccessful SAR operation. Your finding got his spirits up again. Da Pan then joins the discussion. The team decides to use the Endfield zipline to help transport the wounded.

lines.text: Endmin? Everyone... You're all here...
I received reports of a few Landbreakers equipped with UWST gear. I thought...
I thought ... there might be a chance. A slim chance ... that they're still...
But we found nothing. The entire SAR crew ran through the place. Some of us even got wounded...
Thank you... Well, at least this wasn't a wasted trip.
Noffman, you alright...? Finally found you. Looks like the whole team's here — that's a relief.
Were you the ones fighting the Landbreakers before the Endmin arrived? Nicely done!
...Thank you, Mr. Da Pan, but...
With so many casualties, moving quickly isn't possible. But their injuries need immediate care. We must head back at once!
Hey! If we look that way, we can see the Infra-Station!
Yes, there's a big chasm in between, but the direct distance isn't actually that far.
I remember you Endfielders got this ... facility that lets you "SWOOSH" your way across in the mid-air, right?
Are you talking about ⟦key|ziplines⟧...?
Yeah! That's it! Of course! Should we give that a shot?
Alright, sounds good! I'll go check on the injured while you handle that — fingers crossed it's nothing more than scratches.

options: We picked up a few ... things left behind.

r: We picked up a few ... things left behind.

lines.text: These facilities... They look really different compared to UWST machinery.
They look pretty delicate, right? Appearance can be deceiving. Endfield hardware is built to last.
The facilities are in place. Let's start moving the injured.

scenes.summary: You successfully move the injured personnel. Noffman is thankful but he is still thinking about the missing crew mates. With Da Pan's encouragement, the young man manages to get back to his feet and commits himself to the construction of the Infra-Station.

lines.text: ...I could hardly sleep at night these past couple of days. I can't stop thinking about the crew mates who went missing.
It may sound hopeful, but I believe they're still out there, alive...
But I can't put the team's lives at risk again. Not anymore...
Noffman my boy, you saved all of us. You gave dozens of lives a chance. We're counting on you to save more people.
...You're right. We got plenty of people at the Infra-Station. I should ... take proper care of them.
That's the spirit! I'm glad you sorted it out. I say it's time for a meal! Only work when you got food in the belly!
Hey, team! You coming along?
If you believe they're still out there, then we should keep looking! The watch tower is perfect for mounting a signal receiver. If we receive anything, I'll be the first to tell you!
Oh, thank goodness you're here to help us. Everyone is now safe.

options: But you seem to be troubled.

lines.text: Thank you for helping us, Endministrator. If it weren't for you ... things would have been disastrous.
Mr. Da Pan's words inspired me. I'm going to install a signal receiver on the watch tower.
This will help us lock on to SOS signals faster. It'll improve the performance of our SAR operations.
I'm still trying to track down the three missing crew mates whenever I can, but so far ... no luck.
I've noticed that. Though most of the Landbreakers in the Science Park have been cleared out, we still get reports of isolated LB activities.
We'll reinforce our patrols and defensive measures. If necessary, we'll take the initiative and attack as well.
Alright, Endmin. You'll be the first to know if anything comes up.

options: Careful. Some Landbreakers still roam this place.
Getting enough supplies from the AIC Factory?
Carry on. Don't let me take up your time.
